rows.label: Integrity
rows.note: DEFECT FIXED + content ported on native public verify. The screen read top-level type/createdAt/custodyEvents/verificationState/publicUrl — none of which GET /public/verify/:id sends — so the record name, type, date, status and chain of custody were blank on EVERY verification (a test had pinned the fictional `verificationState`). Now parseVerifyView reads the real payload: overview (title, type, verificationStatus, integrityHeadline, capturedAt), humanSummary.summary, evidence items (Primary evidence item, kind, role, Duration m:ss as the web, size, Original: file name), Integrity (SHA-256, Ed25519 fingerprint, Signature, Signing key + version, Public key, RFC 3161 status/provider/time/serial, OpenTimestamps status/proof/anchored, TxID:), Evidence Acquisition (Submitted through/Delivery Channel/Submission/Consent/Submission Status, meaningful-only as VerifyTechnicalMetadataSection), Capture device, custody forensic events + access-event note, Actions (Share verification link — native share sheet in place of clipboard copy: expo-clipboard not installed, download pending approval — and Check Latest Anchoring Status re-reads). Not ported: trust-decision card, signal grid, package-integrity card, reviewer actions, mismatch explanations, media previews (verify/[token] CONTENT_FILE stays open).
rows.evidence: src/product/public-verify.ts (parseVerifyView, formatVerifyDuration, publicVerifyUrl); app/verify.tsx; test/public-verify.render.test.mjs (real-payload case fails on the previous screen)

rows.note: DEFECT FIXED + content ported on native public verify. The screen read top-level type/createdAt/custodyEvents/verificationState/publicUrl — none of which GET /public/verify/:id sends — so the record name, type, date, status and chain of custody were blank on EVERY verification (a test had pinned the fictional `verificationState`). Now parseVerifyView reads the real payload: overview (title, type, verificationStatus, integrityHeadline, capturedAt), humanSummary.summary, evidence items (Primary evidence item, kind, role, Duration m:ss as the web, size, Original: file name), Integrity (SHA-256, Ed25519 fingerprint, Signature, Signing key + version, Public key, RFC 3161 status/provider/time/serial, OpenTimestamps status/proof/anchored, TxID:), Evidence Acquisition (Submitted through/Delivery Channel/Submission/Consent/Submission Status, meaningful-only as VerifyTechnicalMetadataSection), Capture device, custody forensic events + access-event note, Actions (Share verification link — native share sheet in place of clipboard copy: expo-clipboard not installed, download pending approval — and Check Latest Anchoring Status re-reads). Not ported: trust-decision card, signal grid, package-integrity card, reviewer actions, mismatch explanations, media previews (verify/[token] CONTENT_FILE stays open).
